Subject: Multi-year prepay proposal and invoicing options for GreenData

Hi Emma / Pierre —

Thanks again for the detailed usage profile yesterday. I pulled together two concrete prepay structures for GreenData (attached): one annual prepay with a 12-month ramp and one 3-year commitment with stepped ramp. High-level notes below so procurement can review quickly: 

- Pricing: 12-month annual prepay = list rates with a 6% up-front discount for year 1 if paid in EUR; 36-month commit = 10% term discount off list with built-in step-downs as volume ramps (see sheet).
- Ramp schedule: proposed 3-month partial ramp (50% committed capacity) -> months 4–12 to full commit for year 1; subsequent years ramping by agreed cadence. We can model a smoother ramp if you prefer monthly increments.
- Invoicing & FX options: we can invoice from Redwood EU (Ireland) in EUR to avoid USD FX exposure. Option to lock FX (EUR/USD) for 6–12 months at a small fee — helps your budgeting.
- Tax: VAT treatment depends on your billing entity / VAT registration (reverse charge for B2B within EU if you provide a valid VAT ID). Withholding tax (WHT) is uncommon on outbound SaaS from the EU but may apply depending on payer jurisdiction if funds route to Redwood US; we flagged options below for minimizing complexity.

Attachments: RDW_GreenData_MultiYear_Prices_v1.xlsx, Prepay_Entity_Options_v1.pdf (entity-by-entity pros/cons and sample invoices).

If procurement wants, Laura (cc) can run the invoice routing and sample invoice options, and Dylan can model the ramped invoice schedule in HubSpot. Next best step — would you prefer: (A) Redwood EU invoices in EUR (simplest), or (B) Redwood US invoices in USD with an FX lock on your side?

Thanks,
Rishi

Hi Emma / Pierre —

Thanks for the questions — quick answers and a recommended path below. I've attached an updated pricing workbook that includes a 12-month FX lock fee and split invoice examples.

VAT: Correct — if GreenData provides a valid FR VAT number and we invoice from Redwood EU (Ireland), we will put VAT out with reverse charge (line item noting reverse charge applies). We will include your VAT number and the standard reverse-charge annotation on the invoice.

WHT: If you pay an invoice issued by Redwood EU to a Redwood EU bank account (EUR), there should be no US withholding exposure. The WHT risk arises when payment is made to a US entity; routing to Redwood EU eliminates that. We can also provide a certificate of tax residency for Redwood EU on request.

Currency/FX: We can invoice in EUR from Redwood EU and offer a 12-month FX protection (fix EUR reference rate vs. USD) for a 0.6% annualized fee on the prepay amount — we added that option in RDW_GreenData_Pricing_v2.xlsx.

Invoicing cadence: We can do annual invoices for a 3-year commit while preserving the 10% term discount. For accounting, we will generate one invoice per 12-month tranche on signature with payment due per the agreed terms. If you prefer quarterly, we can split further.

Proposed commercial (summary):
- 3-year commit (GDA-2026-3Y-PREPAY)
  - Term discount: 10% off list
  - Payment cadence: Annual tranche invoicing (invoice at T0 for year 1, then year-2 invoice 12 months later, etc.)
  - Ramp: 3-month partial ramp to full capacity in month 4 of year 1
  - FX protection: 12-month lock available at 0.6% on the annual invoice amount (optional)
  - Docs required: copy of your FR VAT registration (for reverse charge) and PO referencing deal id above

I attached: RDW_GreenData_Pricing_v2.xlsx and Entity_Invoicing_Playbook.pdf (sample invoices for Redwood EU and Redwood US).

If that looks good I'll have Laura prepare the sample EUR invoice and the PO / DocuSign flow.

Thanks,
Rishi
